question: Whose research was fundamental in establishing the modern discipline known as surface tension, Which describes the properties of liquid and solid surfaces and interfaces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agnes Pockels.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surface tension is the cohesive force that holds together the molecules on the surface of a liquid.**
 
• **Agnes Pockels was a German physicist who conducted experiments on surface tension in the late 19th century.**
 
• Pockels developed a** method to measure surface tension using a balance and a thin film of liquid on a wire loop**.
 
• **The correct answer is option 4, Agnes Pockels.** 
 
• Her research on surface tension was fundamental in establishing the modern discipline known as surface tension, which describes the properties of liquid and solid surfaces and interfaces. 
 
• Pockels developed a method to measure surface tension using a balance and a thin film of liquid on a wire loop, which laid the foundation for the modern understanding of surface tension and its applications in fields such as chemistry and materials science.
